title: Reading set and summary frame
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: School: what school is like (3.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 54 (Pupil PDF worksheet: reading set and summary frame)
intro: Lesson 54: Reading and summary: a longer text on school life. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

arabic.text: اِنْتَقَلَ يُوسُفُ إِلَى مَدْرَسَةٍ جَدِيدَةٍ عَلَى الإِنْتَرْنِتِ. فِي اليَوْمِ الأَوَّلِ كَانَ قَلِقًا لِأَنَّهُ لَا يَعْرِفُ أَحَدًا. لٰكِنَّ المُعَلِّمَ رَحَّبَ بِهِ، وَسَاعَدَهُ طَالِبٌ اسْمُهُ زَيْدٌ. يُحِبُّ يُوسُفُ دُرُوسَ العُلُومِ لِأَنَّهَا مُمْتِعَةٌ. وَمَعَ ذٰلِكَ، يَشْعُرُ أَحْيَانًا بِالضَّغْطِ بِسَبَبِ الوَاجِبَاتِ الكَثِيرَةِ. لِذٰلِكَ يُنَظِّمُ وَقْتَهُ، وَيَأْخُذُ اسْتِرَاحَةً قَصِيرَةً بَعْدَ كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ.

questions.q: Why was he worried on the first day?
Who helped him? Give two people.
questions.a: The teacher (welcomed him) and a pupil called Zayd

questions.q: Which lessons does he like, and why?
Why does he sometimes feel pressure?
questions.a: Because of the large amount of homework

questions.q: مَاذَا يَفْعَلُ يُوسُفُ بَعْدَ كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ؟
Group B: translate the last two sentences into English.
questions.a: However, he sometimes feels under pressure because of the large amount of homework. So he organises his time and takes a short break after every hour.

blocks.h: Group A: summary (about 30 words, in your own words)

box.title: Cover: worry, welcome and help, what he likes, pressure, how he copes

arabic.text:
اِنْتَقَلَ يُوسُفُ إِلَى مَدْرَسَةٍ جَدِيدَةٍ عَلَى الإِنْتَرْنِتِ.
فِي البِدَايَةِ كَانَ قَلِقًا لِأَنَّهُ لَا يَعْرِفُ أَحَدًا.
لٰكِنَّ المُعَلِّمِينَ رَحَّبُوا بِهِ، وَسَاعَدَهُ زُمَلَاؤُهُ فِي الوَاجِبَاتِ.
الآنَ يُحِبُّ دُرُوسَ العُلُومِ وَالعَرَبِيَّةِ، وَيَقُولُ إِنَّ الصُّفُوفَ الصَّغِيرَةَ مُفِيدَةٌ.
وَمَعَ ذٰلِكَ يَشْعُرُ بِالضَّغْطِ قَبْلَ الاِمْتِحَانَاتِ، فَيُنَظِّمُ وَقْتَهُ وَيَدْعُو اللّٰهَ.

panels.title: Summary rules (Group A)
points: Your own words, not copied sentences

questions.q: Translate into English: وَسَاعَدَهُ زُمَلَاؤُهُ فِي الوَاجِبَاتِ.
questions.a: And his classmates helped him with the homework.

questions.q: Reading set on the pupil PDF (our own questions): five questions in English and three in Arabic on the text. Then Group A: summarise the text in Arabic in about 30 words in your own words (portal response box). Group B: translate the last two sentences into English.
questions.a: Answers per the key; summary covering worry, welcome and help, likes, pressure and how he copes; accurate translation

questions.q: Extend: find two connectives in the text and say what they do.
Why was Yusuf worried at first?
questions.a: A) He did not know anyone. لِأَنَّهُ لَا يَعْرِفُ أَحَدًا.

questions.q: Think again: every word or the big idea?
